statement: For any initial cusp packet and any nonzero Kummer twisting direction kappa_a,l with a rational prime a different from l, all but at most three twists on the stable S3 genus-three cover have full pro-l fixed subgroup equal to selected cusp inertia. The stable genus-two quotient has the same conclusion outside a countable set at every prime, and outside the same at-most-three set at l=2. These equalities hold for every open subgroup of one common Delta0.
depends_on: A.4 explicit covers and Jacobian isogenies; A.22 induced pro-l topology argument for the l=2 transfer; ordinary lower-central Magnus realization
notes: The C3 first Johnson map is D(t)=0, D(v)=[t,(A_delta+n beta I)v], beta=kappa_a,l(delta)/3, with kernel Qt when the six-by-six symplectically self-adjoint matrix is invertible; its determinant is the square of a cubic Pfaffian polynomial. The D3 ordinary degree-one map vanishes by hyperelliptic equivariance; full-rank minors for T0+n beta ad(omega) exclude finitely many twists per Lie degree. Tangential h need not square to identity; all roots of its derivative -1 lie in K^ab. At l=3 the common Delta0 makes kappa divisible by 3. Actual arithmetic matrices and membership of a specified packet in the exceptional sets remain uncomputed. No dependence on R1 for the generic statements.
